DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when Pillar of Frost is active (if they have it talented) or if they don’t use it, combined with any of the following:

  • They are using the Obliteration talent.
  • They have Breath of Sindragosa talented and it is currently active.
  • They do not have either Obliteration or Breath of Sindragosa talented.
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • There is at least 1 active enemy, and the encounter is single-target focused or adds will persist.
  • The Deathknight's Gargoyle pet is active with ≤22 seconds remaining, or they aren’t using Gargoyle but have Army of the Dead active with abomination/ghouls at ≤18 seconds remaining.
  • Dark Transformation is active if they don’t use Gargoyle or Army of the Dead talents.
  • Gargoyle isn’t active and its cooldown (+10s) exceeds Power Infusion’s duration, ensuring alignment with the next Gargoyle cast.
  • Against 3+ enemies while Dark Transformation is active or Death and Decay is damaging targets.
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • The Demonhunter has Metamorphosis active, amplifying their damage window.
  • The encounter will end within 20 seconds to maximize throughput before combat concludes.
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • They activate Celestial Alignment or Incarnation: Chosen of Elune to maximize their burst damage window.
  • They are casting Convoke the Spirits to amplify rapid spellcasting during this channeled ability.
  • Their high-damage cooldowns align with your Power Infusion availability, synchronizing with their burst phases.
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • The Druid has Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane active (buff.bs_inc.up).
  • The Druid does not have the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent selected (!talent.berserk_heart_of_the_lion).
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • They have Dragonrage active and either their Shattering Star is on cooldown, the target already has the Shattering Star debuff, or there are 2+ enemies present
  • The encounter will end within 35 seconds to prevent wasting the cooldown before combat finishes
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • When Trueshot is active and has over 12 seconds remaining.
  • When the encounter is about to end with less than 13 seconds remaining.
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • Coordinated Assault is active.
  • They do not have the Coordinated Assault talent and Spearhead is on cooldown.
  • They have neither the Spearhead nor Coordinated Assault talents.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • They cast Arcane Surge and do NOT have Spymaster’s Web equipped.
  • They cast Evocation and do have Spymaster’s Web equipped.
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • the Mage is about to activate Combustion (within their preparation window)
  • Combustion is active with more than 7 seconds remaining
  • the encounter will end in under 20 seconds
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is not currently active on the target.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • Their Xuen the White Tiger summon is active,
  • Either Bloodlust/Heroism is not active, or if Bloodlust is active, their Strike of the Windlord ability is still on cooldown.
PALADIN_RETRIBUTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Retribution Paladin when:

  • They activate Avenging Wrath or Crusade to amplify their major damage window
  • Their primary target is affected by Execution Sentence to maximize the debuff's burst damage phase
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • they are in Voidform, have Dark Ascension active, or have the tier set's 4-piece bonus active
  • Power Infusion is not already active on them
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • The Rogue's Deathmark ability is currently active (while their damage-over-time effect is actively dealing damage).
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • They have Shadow Dance active, as this signifies their major burst window requiring enhanced haste to amplify combo point generation and finisher damage.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • Ascendance is currently active, synergizing with their burst window.
  • Ascendance has over 30 seconds remaining on its cooldown, ensuring no overlap with their next major DPS phase.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • they activate Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds (prioritizing major cooldown windows).
  • the fight’s final phase is within 20 seconds of a 2-minute cooldown window (e.g., during execute range).
  • their core cooldowns will remain unavailable for over 2 minutes (timed to avoid overlap).
  • they haven’t specialized in Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds (default timing basis).
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • The warlock has activated their major offensive cooldowns (e.g., Darkglare or synergized burst windows), maximizing the benefit of their damage amplification phase.
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • Wild Imps are set to despawn within twice your global cooldown plus Demonic Tyrant's cast time.
  • The Warlock's previous ability was Hand of Gul'dan or Ruination.
  • Either their remaining despawn time is less than one global cooldown plus Demonic Tyrant's cast time, or they have fewer than 2 Soul Shards.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • Infernal is active, allowing coordinated burst with their major cooldown.
  • The warlock does not have Summon Infernal talented, removing alignment requirements.
  • The fight will end before Summon Infernal’s cooldown resets (with 15 seconds of buffer time), ensuring no wasted usage.
  • The remaining fight duration is shorter than Infernal’s next availability plus Power Infusion’s full effect window, but still long enough to benefit fully from it.
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • The target has Colossus Smash applied and the encounter will last over 135 seconds remaining.
  • During the Execute Phase (target below 20% health) while Avatar is active.
  • The encounter is in its final 25 seconds, regardless of other conditions.
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • Avatar has more than 15 seconds remaining and the encounter will last at least 135 more seconds.
  • The target is in Execute range (below 20% health) and Avatar is currently active.
  • The boss will die within 25 seconds, regardless of other cooldowns.
